title: The window from inside, a back
logline: The garage window from inside with a man's back in plaid in front of it, looking out at the alley, the pup at his boot. The page is behind him; the alley is what he's looking at; the page can't see it either.

panels.composition: Inside the garage: a man in blue plaid from behind standing at the casement window looking out, the glass bright and blank with glare, a small three-legged dog at his boot, three jars on the sill.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, inside a garage a man in blue plaid flannel seen from behind standing at a small window bright with glare, a small three-legged dog at his boot and three jars on the sill, no words

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run
art.palette: muted ochres, slate blues, misty sea-foam greens; luminous sunbreaks in the last spring
art.paper: Arches; bristol; the backs of motel registration cards

notes: The page can't see it either.
